task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
The video shows a close-up underwater view of a heavily encrusted, vertical man-made structure, likely a shipwreck or artificial reef, set against a bright, clear blue water background. The structure is densely covered in a mix of white and pale green sponges, patches of reddish-brown algae or coral, and tufts of yellowish-brown seaweed or gorgonians. A distinct, dark, square-shaped opening or window is visible on the left side of the structure. The camera begins with a tight shot of this section and then slowly tilts and pans upwards, revealing more of the vertical column and the open blue water above. Small, indistinct fish can be seen swimming in the background. The lighting is bright and natural, typical of shallow, clear water, causing some overexposure on the white encrustations.

The video shows a close-up underwater view of a heavily encrusted, vertical man-made structure, likely a shipwreck or artificial reef, set against a bright, clear blue water background.
